rule: Owner decision 2026-10-22: "All universities should include all faculty that work on CS-related topics / publish in CS venues (Even if not in CS)." A candidate of hierarchy/cmu/cs-related-candidates.json (DBLP-based: 8+ CMU works 2016-2026, 5+ and 20%+ DBLP-indexed, last author on 30%+ or 30+ works, not already a PI) is accepted when (1) faculty at CMU in some year 2016-2026 in any department: professor ranks incl. research professors; postdocs, research scientists/staff (systems/project scientists), teaching-track faculty without PhD advising, adjunct/courtesy-only, visitors and students do not count; (2) a PI: stated PhD advising 2016-2026 (named in the Advisor(s) field of a CMU dissertation record, KiltHub or the SCS reports archive, or advisees named on a dated page) or a lab they head alone; (3) home department from a dated department listing/profile; (4) appointment years from dated department listings and dated profiles, with a reviewed period (hierarchy/census-overrides.json -> cmu) whenever the dated listings do not span 2016-2026. Emeritus listings end the period; adjunct/courtesy/visiting listings in the home department, and listings naming a post at another university, do not count as appointment years.
